dedupe_keys.name: taiwan actual price registration 實價登錄 batch data sales rentals and pre sales

description: Taiwan requires the actual prices of property transactions to be registered, and the Ministry of the Interior's Department of Land Administration publishes the declared data as open batch files. The current release dataset holds the real estate sales declared nationwide, with a manifest and schema files for the main, building, land and parking tables, published on the 1st, 11th and 21st of each month. Earlier releases are kept quarterly in CSV and XML and cover three streams: property sales, rentals and pre-sale (off-plan) housing sales. Coverage: Taiwan. Access: downloads through the government open data platform and an online price query service, free. Licence: Open Government Data License version 1.0. Caveats: records are declarations by the parties; field lists are in the schema files, which were not read. Simulation uses are property values and building attributes from sales for loss, relocation and investment appraisal models. Related records: the French DVF transactions for a comparable national dataset.
